test_title: PYST 32: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

A large, tall cupboard in which clothes may be hung or stored
solution: The correct answer is **"Wardrobe."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **'Wardrobe'** refers to a large, tall cupboard used for storing or hanging clothes. (कपड़े रखने या टाँगने की अलमारी) • It is a noun and is pronounced as 'wawr-drohb'. • **Example: ***She opened her **wardrobe**__ to find the perfect dress for the party.* • The correct answer is option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Option 2, **Hypergamy**, refers to the practice of marrying someone from a higher social class or caste. (उच्च सामाजिक वर्ग या जाति के किसी व्यक्ति से विवाह करने की प्रथा) • Option 3, **Gibber**, means to speak rapidly and incoherently. (तेजी से और असंगत रूप से बोलना) • Option 4, **Honorary**, refers to something that is given as an honor or recognition, such as an honorary degree. (सम्‍मान के रूप में प्रदत्त (जिसमें व्‍यक्ति को नियमित योग्‍यता के प्रमाण-पत्र की अपेक्षा नहीं होती); सम्‍मानद्योतक) 3e:T960, The correct answer is **"He wondered about lots of things."**
